name: cavemio-chat-history
title: Chat history
description: Past chats grouped by day, searchable, with titles that write themselves, rename in place and delete with Undo.

cavemio.usage:
import { ChatHistory } from "@/components/chat-history";

<ChatHistory chats={chats} activeId={chatId} onSelect={openChat} onNew={newChat} onRename={rename} onDelete={remove} onPin={pin} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- A labelled navigation landmark with a heading per group; the open chat has aria-current="page".
- Up and Down move between chats from anywhere in the list, including the search field.
- Row actions appear on hover and keyboard focus, always on touch screens, and are labelled with the chat ("Delete Pistachio supplier prices").
- Nothing is deleted until Undo has had its chance, so a slip of the finger never costs a conversation.
- With reduced motion, rows move and change state in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: chats
props.description: – · Grouped and sorted for you. Leave title empty (or set generating) while it’s being named.

props.name: activeId / onSelect
props.description: – · The open chat, marked with aria-current.

props.name: onNew
props.description: – · Shows the new-chat button beside search.

props.name: onRename / onPin
props.description: – · Show Rename and Pin on hover or focus.

props.name: onDelete / undoWindow
props.description: — / 5000 · Called once the undo window has passed, after the row has folded away.

props.name: searchable / defaultQuery
props.description: true / "" · The search field and its starting text.

features.title: Grouped by day
features.description: Pinned, Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days, then month names. It regroups at midnight.

features.title: New chats name themselves
features.description: A new chat shimmers “New chat” until its title is generated, then the title types itself in.

features.title: Search as you type
features.description: Rows filter as you type, the match is highlighted and the rows that stay glide up to close the gaps.

features.title: Pin, rename and delete in the row
features.description: The actions appear on hover or focus, and always on touch screens. Rename turns the row into a field.

features.title: Delete with Undo
features.description: The title gives way to “Chat deleted · Undo”. Nothing is deleted until the undo window has passed.

features.title: Keyboard and landmarks
features.description: Up and Down move between chats, the list is a navigation landmark and the open chat is marked as current.

states.title: grouped
states.description: Newest first under Pinned, Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days, then month names. It regroups at midnight.

states.title: new
states.description: "New chat" shimmers while generating is true; the title then types in once.

states.title: search
states.description: Rows filter as you type and the ones that stay glide to their new places (420ms); the match is highlighted, Escape clears, and an empty search says so.

states.title: pin
states.description: The row glides from its group into Pinned (and back) instead of jumping; the pin icon blurs into unpin.

states.title: rename
states.description: The same row becomes a field, its outline fading in, with the title selected; Enter or leaving saves, Escape cancels.

states.title: deleted
states.description: The title blurs out as "Chat deleted · Undo" fades in for undoWindow, then the row folds away and onDelete is called.
